status: frozen before any run; deterministic arm runnable; model and human arms NOT_RUN
author: VozNativa developer's agent (not independent). Cases written after the v0.7.0 CP5-CP9D rules; synthetic own text, no corpus text
class: out-of-distribution conformance of deterministic decisions across genre, epoch, variety, length and task; not a quality benchmark
metrics: separate per check family: routing, protections, decision (false edit on natural text), semantic gate (preservation), slang sense, variety, long-form, diagnosis; each with a Wilson 95% interval and per-axis groups with their n; no single combined score

not_run_arms.model: no budget approved for paid model calls

freeze_rule: cases file not edited after this commit; a wrong expectation is reported as a case error and fixed only in a later suite
bias_disclosure: same agent wrote rules, cases and runner; passing shows conformance to the specification, not reader quality; small n per group
